commands.root: StarBuddy — org materials, blueprints and crafting
commands.ping: Check bot latency and backend health
commands.orgManager: Grant or revoke an org's manager role
commands.optionRemove: Remove the manager role instead of granting it
commands.craftable: What your org can craft right now — optionally only recipes using a material
commands.need: Who has the blueprint and materials — by item name or category (shield, powerplant, undersuit…)
commands.optionSearch: Only recipes whose name contains this
commands.optionItem: Item or blueprint name, or a category like shield / powerplant / undersuit
commands.optionCraftableSearch: A material you have (lists recipes that use it) or part of a recipe name
commands.status: Current Star Citizen service status (maintenance, outages)

common.error: Something went wrong while running that command.
common.backendError: Something went wrong talking to the StarBuddy backend. Please try again later.
common.notRegistered: You are not registered with StarBuddy yet. Sign in on the website first.

whoami.registered: You are registered with StarBuddy as **{{handle}}**.
whoami.notRegistered: You are not registered with StarBuddy yet. Link your Discord account on the website to get started.
whoami.unreachable: Could not reach the StarBuddy backend. Please try again later.

stash.comingSoon: Coming in P2 — browse the ledger at the website.

org.managerRevoked: **{{member}}** is no longer a manager of **{{org}}** (role: {{role}}).

craftable.none: Nothing is craftable right now — add materials to the ledger.
craftable.noneMatching: Nothing matching "{{search}}" is craftable right now.
craftable.noneWithMaterial: No recipe using **{{material}}** is craftable right now.

need.categoryMore_one: …and {{count}} more — search a name for details.
need.categoryMore_other: …and {{count}} more — search a name for details.

status.allClear: No maintenance or incidents reported on the RSI status page.
status.shutdown: **Servers offline at {{time}} ({{relative}})** — stow your ships and gear before then.
status.unavailable: Could not read the service status right now ({{error}}).
